task_title: Unify Floor 2 generated equipment inventory and loot-box rewards

plan_review.notes: Rejected ambiguous lootBox overloading and incomplete two-read-site migration. Revised to an explicit lootTable discriminator with ADR updates, one identity-preserving inventory query model, Common output normalization plus validation, instance-key UI state, and aligned/opposite/neutral pool tests. The explicit discriminator preserves the user-mandated loot-box concept while structurally separating Floor 1 materials from Floor 2 generated equipment.
